findings.title: No bare-hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed.
findings.comment: An employee was observed scooping ice with a single service cup using their bare hands. Education was carried out. The ice was discarded and the container cleaned and sanitized while inspector was present. Ensure that employees are educated and reminded to always use gloves when handling ready to eat food items. Moreover, ensure that employees use the scoop to dip ice from the bins to fill cups for drinks.
findings.citation_text: 3-301.11(B) Preventing Contamination from Hands. (B) Except when washing fruits and vegetables as specified under §3-302.15 or as specified in (D) and (E) of this section, FOOD EMPLOYEES may not contact exposed, READY-TO-EAT FOOD with their bare hands and shall use suitable UTENSILS such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, single-use gloves, or dispensing EQUIPMENT.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The internal surfaces of the coffee and tea makers and the frappe machine were observed with soil accumulations. Discussed with PIC. The tea and coffee makers and frappe machine were immediately cleaned and sanitized. Ensure that food contact surfaces such as the ones mentioned above are constantly monitored, cleaned, and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sani buckets were measured at 0 ppm at the beginning of today’s inspection. PIC was made aware. PIC instructed a staff member to remake the sani buckets. The sani buckets were remade and tested at 100 ppm. Ensure that the sanitizer concentration is routinely checked throughout the day.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed mop buckets being stored improperly with dirty water in them as well as the mop heads. PIC was made aware of the proper storing procedures and actions were taken to get this violation corrected. Ensure that staff are aware of the proper procedures for storing mop heads and the disposal wastewater.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.15 Cleaning Maintenance Tools, Preventing Contamination. FOOD preparation sinks, HANDWASHING SINKS, and WAREWASHING EQUIPMENT may not be used for the cleaning of maintenance tools, the preparation or holding of maintenance materials, or the disposal of mop water and similar liquid wastes.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed soil accumulation in the nozzles of the soda dispenser in the lobby area. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured Inspector that the soda dispenser nozzles will be cleaned to sight of touch. Ensure that food-contact surfaces such as the soda dispenser nozzles are monitored and cleaned at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the build up of food debris under the fryers by the drive through pickup window. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that the relevant cleaning will be done. Ensure that closed spaces such as the one mentioned are routinely monitored and cleaned to avoid the build up of food debris.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.12 Cleaning, Frequency and Restrictions. (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following were observed in disrepair.
1. The caulking on the hand sink in the kitchen area was observed in disrepair.
2. The door handle to the walk-in cooler was observed in disrepair. 
PIC was made aware about the above mentioned disrepair in the facility. PIC told inspector that a ticket had been put in to get the walk-in cooler repair and that the hand sink will be re-caulked accordingly. Ensured that relevant repairs are done for the above mentioned items.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Accumulated ice buildup was observed on the ceiling and behind the fan unit in the walk-in freezer. PIC was made aware of the accumulated ice buildup and PIC ensured inspectors that the accumulated ice will be cleaned. Ensure that the ice buildup is removed and that the walk-in is routinely checked for ice accumulation to prevent food contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: No bare hand contact with RTE food or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed
findings.comment:
3-301.11: During the inspection, an employee was observed using the cup dispensed at the drive thru as a scoop for ice. This behavior was corrected on site and the employee was educated on the importance of utilizing the scoop present versus using the cup as a scoop. Ensure that a scoop with a handle is used when scooping ice from the ice bin. 
3-301.11: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall properly wash hands (C). (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall not contact RTE FOODS with bare hands  except washing fruits and veggies (P). (C) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall minimize contact with FOOD that is not RTE (Pf). (D) Contact does not apply to RTE Food being added as ingredient to be cooked. (E) FOOD EMPLOYEES not serving a HSP may contact exposed, RTE with bare hands if approved.
